# PDF preview dependency

PDF.js pdfjs-dist 6.3.289, Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE).
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/6.3.289
Vendored legacy build, worker, character maps, fonts and WebAssembly assets.
Loaded from the same origin; no external CDN is required for student documents.
Only the browser preview consumes this dependency. Upload validation remains on the backend.
